//: UNCHECKED_READS_ALLOWLIST.json — read by src/scripts/checkUncheckedSupabaseReads.ts. Keys are structural: <file>::<enclosing fn>::<table>.<terminal>[#n]. Every entry is validated on every run: a key that matches no in-scope site FAILS (delete the line when the site is fixed), a benign entry under 40 chars FAILS, a known_defects note not starting with FAIL-OPEN: / FAIL-CLOSED: / UNCLASSIFIED: FAILS.
//benign: Sites where an empty-or-errored answer is genuinely the right one and nothing needs to know (label lookups, ranking enrichment). Permanent, with a rationale that stands on its own.
//known_defects: The burn-down ledger (same device as SILENT_SUPABASE_WRITES_BASELINE.json): in-scope reads that ignore .error TODAY, owned by other lanes. Classified 2026-09-07 by reading each site; FAIL-OPEN means a DB error yields the permissive/affirmative/destructive outcome, FAIL-CLOSED means it yields a silent denial or skip, UNCLASSIFIED means the consumer was not traced. This list may only shrink.
